name: Dokidoki Closet
original_name: どきどきクローゼット
source:
The tests are over, and summer vacations begin. Suddenly a girl falls from a closet before main character. She turns out to be from a spirit wold. Her intention is to help people with the power of changing clothes.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
考试结束，暑假开始了。一名少女突然从主人公的衣柜里跌落出来。原来她来自精灵世界，打算运用换装的力量帮助人们。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
